title: Left path of the coefficient tensor square on representatives
statement: For any good integral cochain representatives P,Q, pre composed with the left derived tensor/reduction/pullback path and then post is leftNormal, namely the derived image of the ordinary left cochain path, conjugated by the prescribed representative maps.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the realization comparison to the ordinary tensor representative, and naturality of the system tensor comparison to the reduction-model components. Normalize the reduction tensor comparison using mu_model. Use the defining system tensor representative square and naturality of the exact pullback factorization on the strict reduction map. The realization model equation for the total tensor completes the path. Paste these six equations using associativity.

from.place: Proved representative normalization, split into files to respect the per-file compile limit.

lean.statement:
theorem left_on_representatives
    (o : Operations l E) (m : RealizationModel l E o) (d : RingedModels l E)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) (P Q : (good l E V).FullSubcategory) :
    pre l E o m d f P Q ≫
        (leftPath l E o m d f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
        post l E o m d f P Q = leftNormal l E o m d f P Q
